newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hospitalized Mexico labor boss recuperating - doctor.
newsitem.headline: Hospitalized Mexico labor boss recuperating - doctor.

text.p: Powerful Mexican labor leader Fidel Velazquez is recuperating in a Mexico City hospital from an intestinal infection, his doctor said on Wednesday.
Velazquez, the longtime leader of the six-million-strong Mexican Workers Confederation (CTM), entered the ABC Hospital on Tuesday.
"Things are going well. He is recuperating satisfactorily," Salomon Jasqui told Reuters. "His appetite is not very good yet, but I expect to send him home on the weekend."
Velazquez, 96, has run the CTM for more than half a decade during which he has been a staunch ally of the ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) and helped keep a lid on labor unrest.
Velazquez has been hospitalized twice in the past five months and at least three times in the past year.
He has no obvious successor at the CTM.
